title: ephemeral-agents POC task message (v1)
description: The inter-zone contract: the message the manager publishes to the agent.tasks topic, consumed by the M1 adapter. Owned by the M1 delivery plan (WP-1.1).

task_id.description: Unique task identifier and THE idempotency key: the Temporal workflow ID is task_id (WP-1.3). Duplicate task_id = no second workflow.

agent_ref.description: repo location + repo folder containing the agent's markdown (persona, skill, tools) - diagram Note 1.

behavioral_spec.description: The Behavioral Specification passed by the manager (diagram Note 1).

repo_target.description: Project Repo the coder writes code to.

requester.description: Who asked - carries the response path. The two-way Manager-RabbitMQ response is correlated on task_id (no separate correlation_id: task_id is the single identifier for request and response).

ttl_s.description: OPTIONAL - the manager is the ONLY writer; sized max(3 x B1 boot-time p50, brief estimate). When absent, M2's lifecycle applies POC_TTL_DEFAULT (900s). The reaper is authoritative either way (R1 backstop).
